reviews.text:
The Blue Lagoons Pool and Spa were exceptional throughout the entire process. Katie was great to work with on the design. She was the one that set the tone for the whole project! Todd followed it up with incredible attention to detail and was on site throughout the remodel. He was very knowledgeable and made sure everything was completed exactly as it should be. The contractors that Blue Lagoons used were always friendly, did excellent work, and always cleaned up after themselves! Alyssa and Yarisa made sure we were always informed on what was completed and what was scheduled the following week. Pete, owner, was involved in the whole process, and available when things needed more clarification.

Our project included: New plaster, new waterline tile, putting green, turf, in-ground trampoline, retaining wall, slide, fire pit, basketball goal, decking, added bar to existing grill station.

The scope of work shows that the Blue Lagoons team can do it all and their price is competitive. If you’re looking for a great pool company, don’t wait. Give them a call!
reviews.author: Shawn

reviews.text: We cannot say enough incredible things about our experience and outcome of our beautiful pool through Blue Lagoons! From the moment our design coordinator, Victor, came out to measure and get ideas, to meeting our project manager Todd, interaction with all the crews and their AMAZING landscape crew Platinum Scape (owner Gabriel) we have been blown away. They were great with communication, updated on timelines, and kept us informed. This is not our first pool to build and they outdid our expectations in many ways. We recommend Blue Lagoons for your outdoor oasis 100%!
reviews.author: Kalena Rigney

reviews.text: Blue Lagoons did a really nice job remodeling our pool ledge, fixing some of our coping and replacing our mastic. We shopped our relatively small job with a number of competitors and were really impressed with the great employees at Blue Lagoons. Their quote was very competitive and they were prompt did exactly what they said they would finishing on time and at budget. I highly recommend them
reviews.author: Bill Heck

reviews.text: Prior to building our new pool, we searched extensively with local pool builders and met with several who shared design, build elements, etc.  We chose Blue Lagoons to build our new pool.  From the initial consultation, throughout the building process and the finished product itself, we were more than satisfied.  Every person we dealt with at Blue Lagoons was the epitome of a professional.  This is not our first pool builders so, we came into it having a bit of background.  The build quality is fantastic, the equipment is very high quality and the build finish is fantastic.  We love every element of our outdoor space.  The pool, decking and outdoor kitchen were exactly the way we had envisioned it.  If your considering putting in a pool, definitely consider Blue Lagoons.
reviews.author: Harley Norris

reviews.text: Blue Lagoons pool did a wonderful job on our pool! From start to finish, everyone in the company was very communicative with us.They would alert us when contractors would be coming over and kept us informed on the progress of the project. Also, want to give a shout out to Todd our project manager. He did a wonderful job keeping us up to date, any questions we had and coming by several times overseeing the project. Great company all around.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Fletcher

reviews.text:
Blue Lagoons Pools knocked it out of the park! We absolutely love our new pool! The communication with this builder is a solid 10 out of 10. They set you up with a dedicated team who’s there for you every step of the way.

From day one, we were able to design the pool we envisioned with Will, who listened to our needs and requests perfectly. Alex and Todd, our amazing project managers, were always available whenever we had questions, concerns, or wanted to make changes. And Alyssa, the real MVP, kept us informed every step of the way, letting us know what was scheduled, who would be arriving, and how long they’d be there.

Finally, a huge shoutout to Erik, Alex, and Rico, the best start-up crew ever! They came daily to brush, check water levels, inspect the equipment, and patiently answer all my (many) questions, always with kindness and professionalism.

Not only is our pool gorgeous, it’s built like a tank, a really pretty tank. Blue Lagoons follows strict construction guidelines and works with top notch contractors who are courteous, respectful of our property, and clearly know their craft. Our pool isn’t just stunning, it’s rock-solid and built to last!

Bottom line, between the communication, knowledge, attention to detail, and quality of product, we would recommend Blue Lagoons Pools again and again!
reviews.author: Jennifer Back

reviews.text: A big thank you shout-out to The Blue Lagoons team for our new pool.  William's design, Alyssa's organization, Alex's project management, and Jason's attention to detail and process made the experience a good one.  We began six months ago with an empty back yard and now we have a truly wonderful place to relax an entertain.  We can highly recommend The Blue Lagoons!  Pierce & Cody
reviews.author: Pierce Ables

reviews.text: Wow! Where do I begin? My husband and I couldn't be happier with our experience! From the initial meeting with Victor to the final product. From the beginning, communication was clear, professional, and consistent. Due to this being our first time having an inground pool built we received additional quotes before choosing The Blue Lagoons and we were extremely happy with our decision.  The BL team answered every question and we were always informed of the next steps. Our project manager Alex was patient and always answered the plethora of questions we had throughout the duration of the project. The entire process from dig day to final completion took 90 days as estimated. We absolutely love our new pool and if you are considering having a pool built we highly recommend this company!
reviews.author: Lekesia Scholl

reviews.text: We added an in ground pool, plus a patio extension to our house and an outdoor kitchen. Blue Lagoons - from estimate to finish - was communicative, thorough, detailed and can I tell you, clean! Our neighbors kept commenting how the alley and grounds were left each day tidy. Final product is gorgeous and exactly what was planned.
reviews.author: Sharon Leath

reviews.text:
We recently worked with Blue Lagoon for our first-ever pool build, and the experience was nothing short of amazing from start to finish. The entire process was smooth and seamless, thanks to their incredible team.

From the beginning, LeeAnn truly understood our vision and helped bring it to life. Communication was excellent throughout the entire project, and our project manager, Austin, was fantastic. Even after the project was completed, he has been incredibly responsive and happy to assist with any questions we’ve had.

We’ve also been using their service team for weekly maintenance, and they’ve been awesome. Their professionalism and attention to detail have made pool ownership a breeze.

As first-time pool builders, we were a bit nervous going into this process, but Blue Lagoon completely exceeded our expectations. We would 100% recommend them to anyone considering a pool project!
reviews.author: Kristie Masinelli

reviews.text: The Blue Lagoons was the best company to work with on our pool renovation.  Professionalism from beginning to end and regular communication throughout the entire process.  Katie was great to work with during the design phase and Austin was fantastic as our project manager.  We could not be happier with the final product.  They were the best decision we made for our remodel.
reviews.author: Stan Burks

reviews.text: What an incredibly great experience working with The Blue Lagoons to build my pool! From start to finish, the pool was done in just under 3 months. They have a fantastic team who is efficient in all aspects of design and construction. Could not be happier with the finished product and can’t wait to use the pool this summer. Highly recommend Blue Lagoons if you are looking for a solid pool builder.
reviews.author: Eric Bodiwala

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Blue Lagoons. From the first meeting, to design to pool construction and completion, they listened to us, guided us when we had questions about tile/stone selections and kept us informed throughout the entire process. Loving the finished product and now use them for our pool maintenance.
reviews.author: Connie Piloto

reviews.text: From the very beginning Blue Lagoon was easy to work with, great communication skills all around. They kept us up to date about what was going to happen next, no surprises. Very caring which was helpful in the planning and decision making phase as well as throughout the entire building process. We are super happy with our beautiful pool
reviews.author: Christiane Roehrborn

reviews.text: With many choices out there for pool companies I must say we are extremely grateful that we chose Blue Lagoon to build us a beautiful backyard oasis. We had a vision for what we wanted and they came through clutch. From the very beginning of this project to the final product I can’t say enough about how beautiful the vision turned out. All of the project team members were amazing and helpful with our requests and needs. Behind the scenes there is a group of ladies that honestly in my opinion really run the show. They are an amazing group that keeps the wheels on the track and makes sure things happen. Great experience and great quality. Definitely don’t be fooled and go with another company. Blue Lagoon is the bees knees.
reviews.author: Tim Orten

reviews.text: Blue Lagoons did an incredible job updating our 90s style pool to make it timeless and so much more functional. The team was prompt, communicative, helpful and knowledgeable, and after getting multiple quotes, budget friendly. We liked working with them so much we are keeping them on for our weekly maintenance. 5 star experience all around.

reviews.text:
I’ve debated writing this…but after talking with other pool professionals I feel it necessary.
Late May of this year I reached out to this company for a one time clean, followed by weekly cleans. I chose them because in the near future we will need to do a full renovation of the pool. Our pool was in rough shape, and they were well aware of that. This was our first Summer ever with a pool.

They gave me the quote for the one time clean, I approved and they started work. They said we needed some replacement parts. I approved. A few of weeks go by and they had serviced it a few times but the pool was still very murky and NOT swimmable. At this point no one had been to service the pool in over a week. So, I called the office to check in and see if the “one time clean” was complete and if we were on a rotation for weekly cleans. They said they were working on getting us on a weekly schedule and to send pictures of the pool.

It took a few more visits before the pool was clear, but once it was you could clearly see algae on the sides of the pool.  I let them do their thing, but mentioned it to the employee doing our services.

A couple more weeks go by and the algae is getting worse despite their weekly services.
June 26th they email me with the subject “SANITATION ISSUES” in all caps. They said that our dog swimming in the pool is resulting in them using “more than twice the chemicals” in our pool. We have one dog that swims maybe 1-3 times a week.

I emailed back and said that we will limit or eliminate the dog in the pool and to please advise on what we can do to treat the pool so that they won’t have to use as many chemicals.

I mention the growing algae in the pool and send pictures. Stating that this was an issue that has increased and doesn’t seem to be taken care of. I assumed that this was INCLUDED in the one time clean since our pool had NEVER been back to 100% clean after we paid for this service. I get NO RESPONSE after voicing my concern.

At this point, I talk to the maintenance employee again about the algae. He assures me that it should clear up “within a week or so”.

I stay patient. In the meantime I notice our Polaris isn’t running. At all. I turn it on and off myself to keep the pool clean. Maybe he just forgot to set it.

3 weeks go by, Algae has completely taken over our pool. Our Polaris isn’t running. I text our maintenance man about the Polaris. He says he will look at it on the next visit. He comes and goes. Polaris was never touched or tested.

I email again July 14th about the algae and the Polaris. They say it will be an additional $825 for the algae removal and that the Polaris was “running when he left”.

I had video evidence that the maintenance worker did not touch the Polaris and it was NOT running when he left. So I sent it to them. At this point I cancelled all services with them.

I NEVER got a response back from the company after cancelling services. But they sure made sure to bill me!

To top it off, our pool pump was leaking and burned up the motor because of the settings they had it set to. No mention of this problem to us! So now we have to purchase a new pump because of their negligence.

It still baffles me that they mentioned our dog swimming but not the COPIOUS amounts of algae in the pool or leaking pump. I’ll also note the pictures of our pool that they took were conveniently taken into the sun or at portions of the pool that didn’t have algae. I’ve attached pictures of what our pool really looked like when I decided to cancel services.

It appears people are pleased with their pool installation. But please know that they do not have the knowledge to service an existing pool.

We’re back to where we started and out a couple thousand thanks to this company.

There is SO much more, but if you have read this far I think you get the gist. I’d LOVE for someone from this company to respond seeing as their customer service solution is to just NOT respond.

I feel like they went the cheap way out with our “one time clean” and were banking on Algaecide and a prayer.

reviews.text: Blue Lagoons installed our new pool at our home. It was truly a turn key process. They are very informative and professional!
reviews.author: Anthony Davis

reviews.text: When considering building a pool, we were recommended The Blue Lagoons by some friends and we're glad we listened. Starting with the design phase through completion, the staff of The Blue Lagoons was always professional and responsive to our wants and needs. Victor helped us design exactly what we were looking for in a pool and spa, and the rest of the team executed executed flawlessly. From the time we were under contract through completion, we received frequent updates via a group text to track progress of the pool and plan out necessary next steps. Austin and Salvador were out frequently to check on the progress and make sure the pool was being built and finished to our specifications. They were knowledgeable and did a good job of describing the "why and how" of certain building and operating processes, as we're first time pool owners.  We're happy we went with The Blue Lagoons.
reviews.author: Dustin Peter

reviews.text: The Blue Lagoons is a great co. I'm always able to send a text is i have an issue or a question about my pooland get replies same day. Jose does a great job cleaning my pool very professional and friendly service! I would recommend.
reviews.author: Denise Rodriguez

reviews.text: We bought a spec home and Blue Lagoon Pools had already been chosen by the builder to put the pool in. Even though we didn’t choose them ourselves, they were still fantastic to work with. LeeAnn helped us select final tile and stone colors and was open to some minor hard scape changes to tie in to our landscape plans. The finished product looks fantastic and integrates perfectly with our landscaping. We were so impressed with them we now use them for weekly cleaning and maintenance. I would highly recommend Blue Lagoon Pools.
reviews.author: Tom Sanders

reviews.text:
From the outset, my experience with Blue Lagoon Pools has been nothing short of exceptional. As someone who's cautious about referrals, I've found myself confidently recommending their services to multiple clients, each time with stellar feedback.

What sets Blue Lagoon Pools apart is their unwavering dedication to their clients. They operate with a customer-centric approach that makes you feel valued throughout the entire process. The team is well-known for their superior communication.

Timeliness is another aspect where Blue Lagoon Pools shines. In the world of construction, deadlines can often be aspirational at best, but this company stands by their word. Each project I've been involved with was completed on schedule, which in itself is a testament to their professionalism and efficiency.

More than just contractors, the artisans at Blue Lagoon Pools have a keen eye for design and beauty. The final product is always breathtaking—a harmonious blend of form and function that transforms any outdoor space into a serene oasis. Their attention to detail is evident in the meticulous crafting of each pool, designed to cater to the unique tastes and requirements of their clientele.

But it's not just about the aesthetics; Blue Lagoon Pools prioritizes quality and durability, ensuring that the beauty is not transient. Their pools are built to last, becoming the centerpiece of their clients' homes for years to come.

In summary, if you're looking for a reliable, customer-oriented company to bring your dream pool to life, look no further than Blue Lagoon Pools. Their commitment to excellence, timely delivery, and the ability to create a magnificent product truly sets them apart. I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone eager to enhance their property with a touch of aquatic splendor.
reviews.author: Leighton Pinkham, Regal Realtors

reviews.text: My parents are loving their new pool!! Service was professional, done in a timely manner, and notified of any changes and the next steps to take.
reviews.author: arnada jackson

reviews.text: Working with Blue Lagoons for our backyard pool and kitchen build was a great experience! Their pricing was fair and not inflated like many other companies. Communication was  consistent as we always were kept in the loop about next steps and status. They worked steadily and efficiently. We were so happy with the quality and outcome of our overall build. I highly recommend Blue Lagoons for your pool build!
reviews.author: Sabrina Adamo-Lomonte

reviews.text: Blue Lagoons were great to work with!  From start to finish they were extremely knowledgeable, responsive, and punctual. They custom designed a pool that met our needs and space and finished in record time (less than 3 mths). We are so excited to enjoy our new backyard this summer and would highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Bonnie LeVecchio

reviews.text: I have read and heard so many horror stories about working with pool companies that it gives me the shakes just thinking about hiring someone to do a refresh. I don’t leave many reviews, but I will say Blue Lagoons is worthy of one. I was incredibly surprised at the promptness, professionalism, flexibility and overall work product for our Lakewood pool. We are very pleased with the light refresh that we had done to our pool which included new plaster, mastic, new grout, and new tile. As with anything, sometimes there are a little snags, but everything was dealt with extremely quickly on their end, which is to be applauded, especially in the world of Pool companies. We actually are considering reaching out to them for landscaping work as well. Highly recommended and will be going back for future pool work if ever needed. I will need to update this with photos, but it really was a great experience.
reviews.author: Dustin Stone

reviews.text: The Blue Lagoons is absolutely the BEST choice for your new pool build - from our very first meeting with Katie, our pool designer, and Pete, the owner, we were blown away by their excellent communication, customer service, and creativity. They were adaptable throughout the design process to our numerous tweaks and requests and provided competitive pricing as well. We loved that they created a group text with us, the owner, project manager, and other key contacts in our project so we were kept apprised of every update and knew when to expect each crew to arrive. They also installed a camera in the backyard so we could check in on the progress even when we weren’t at home, which was a nice perk. We were given an estimated 3 month construction timeframe and it was almost exactly 3 months from excavation to plaster (we’ve had friends who have used other companies and it’s taken twice or even triple the time to build their pools). Overall, we were so thrilled with the proces s and results and are so excited about our new backyard!
reviews.author: Keegan Bagalay

reviews.text: Great experience building our pool. The Blue Lagoons guys were on-time, communicative and did exactly as planned. We had some delays due to our home builder and these guys accommodated our needs without giving us a hard time. We would definitely recommend them. We're also using them to do our weekly pool service and the guy shows up as scheduled and always follows our directions and locks up after he leaves.
reviews.author: Heeseon Suki

reviews.text: We have used Blue Lagoons for over 10 years and have been very happy with their services.  Jose, our pool tech, does an excellent job.  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Stephanie S.

reviews.text: The Blue Lagoons has been an amazing company to work with since Day 1 of looking for a company to build our dream pool. My family & I have worked with the majority of their entire team & they have all been a pleasure to work with. Thanks a ton to Will, Jason, Pete, Austin, Alex, Kristen & Alan. Each one of these employees played a key role in ensuring we were informed & happy with the entire process. I’d highly recommend The Blue Lagoons to anyone looking to build, remodel or maintain their pool. Thanks again team!!!
reviews.author: Alex Knagg

reviews.text: Great experience from start to finish. We worked with Will, who was very informative and provided us with a perfect pool design for our yard. The team is very responsive and provides updates every week during the process. We would highly recommend The Blue Lagoons for a new pool installation!
reviews.author: Blanca Quijada

reviews.text: Recently purchased a foreclosed home in Plano which had a swimming pool and honestly it just wasn't up to par with how I wanted it to be for when I had guest's over.  It needed new tile and I wanted to change the color of the plaster and overall just a whole makeover of the pool.  I had did my research for pool companies in the Dallas/Fort Worth area and called numerous places and got pricing and even asked friends that have pools at their houses.  After extensive research and through word of mouth I was recommended to The Blue Lagoons.  I called and spoke with Cyril and he went over what they offer and informed me that he deals with the service and maintenance side of the company.  He was very polite and professional, he reassured me that The Blue Lagoons would definitely be the ones to take care of my needs and would do it in a reasonably time manner.  He told me that Jason and Pete would be the ones to handle the remodeling for me, that they were extremely knowledgeable in that department.  Jason reached out to me,  I sent him over a few pictures of my pool and described to him what I'd like to do and told him that I was on a budget which he understood.  I sat down with Jason and Pete and they showed me a few samples of everything that they thought that I would like on my pool and I loved all of the samples!  Needles to say that The Blue Lagoons gave me a VERY good price and took very good care of me and handled all of my needs.  I am extremely happy with how my pool turned out.  I now can have friends and family over and not have to worry about how my pool is looking and am ready for it to used on a regular basis.  I will also continue to use The Blue Lagoons for their weekly service on my pool and equipment.
reviews.author: Ryan Thomas

reviews.text: The Blue Lagoons was very easy to work with. They were timely not only through the bid and design process but also the installation of the pool. All of the sub contractors spoke very highly of them and were also very courteous, knowledgeable and punctual. We love our finished product and can't wait to enjoy many years swimming in our pool!
reviews.author: Tobin McKearin

reviews.text: Blue Lagoons is a first class organization, especially my project manager Austin Costley.  I had a bad pump, and my current company I use to clean the pool charged me double what BL did.  Austin personally picked up my needed parts, organized installation, and checked on completion.  I got regular updates on progress, when techs would arrive, and follow up communication on my satisfaction.  I live in Greenville, so as soon as BL starts service up in this area, I am switching!!  I am also planning a new home build with a new pool, you bet I will be asking them to bid on the project!!  As for my current pool company, take notice.  Your service is sub par!
reviews.author: Dave Claude

reviews.text: I have been doing business with The Blue Lagoons for many years! They know what they are doing and are very easy to work with. I highly recommend them for anyone looking to build a pool.
reviews.author: Kasey

reviews.text:
We had such a great experience with Blue Lagoon and could not be happier with the end result!! Our pool is absolutely gorgeous and not just the pool, but the entire project which includes the decking, grill station, and landscaping.
We found Blue Lagoon from seeing their sign in the neighborhood, but ended up choosing Blue Lagoon because they were one of the only pool companies that actually called us back and did not charge us initially to provide us with a design.  They communicated with us throughout the entire process and despite the major rain delays we still get to enjoy our beautiful pool for the Summer.  We are very satisfied customers and our backyard now looks like a resort!!!
reviews.author: Amanda Hanu

reviews.text: Very pleased with Blue Lagoons...from concept to implementation, they were professional every step of the way.  End result is fabulous and came in under budget.
reviews.author: M BW

reviews.text: Blue Lagoons built our new pool and we were very happy with the process and the finished product. From the beginning, Chad and Pete were easy to work with and made the process pretty easy.  Each crew that showed up was professional and did excellent work. Blue Lagoons managed the entire project from excavation to final landscaping.
reviews.author: Kevin Leathers

reviews.text: We contracted with Blue Lagoons to help us design and build our pool.  They were thorough and patient with us in the design phase, allowing for numerous redesigns along the way.  The construction folks were respectable and did their jobs well. There were not any “hidden” fees and they were up front with all of our costs with in the budgeting phase. Our finished product has been even better than we anticipated in the beginning!
reviews.author: Elizabeth Smith

reviews.text: We relocated to a new house and have been wanting a new pool to go with it. We contact Blue Lagoon and they met with us, and we were able to design the whole pool/backyard layout with a 3d model. We then hired them to carry out the construction process and now that the pool is complete, we are very happy with the results. The build-out process was smooth. Each day they cleaned up their equipment, were very polite, and transparent about how the process was going. We would definitely recommend the Blue Lagoons for new pool construction!
reviews.author: Evelyn Gutierrez

reviews.text: Our HOA just switched pool servicing companies a few months ago to Blue Lagoons. They have been fantastic in helping us get the chemicals right in the water and getting our pool to where it needs to be for all our members to enjoy. Glenn is fantastic, and we just replaced all the sand both our sand filters. 450 lbs of sand in each one! Natalie in the office has also been amazing! Extremely helpful, communicative, and friendly. I highly recommend!
